name: ae-devtools-vscode-extension
description: After Effects development loop for VSCode — discover/inspect/execute/verify over the shared ae-devtools core (fake and a8n sessions)

ae-devtools.session.description: Session backend for dev-loop commands. 'fake' is codec-faithful mock evidence only; 'a8n' opens an owned AE session via ae-a8n (requires ae-devtools.aeA8nRoot).

ae-devtools.aeA8nRoot.description: Path to an ae-a8n checkout used when ae-devtools.session is 'a8n'.

ae-devtools.installDir.description: AE install directory forwarded to the a8n session opener (a8n session only).

ae-devtools.debug.hostAppSpecifier.description: Host specifier for the Adobe.extendscript-debug attach configuration (e.g. aftereffects-27.0). The authoritative string is shown by the extension's app picker — offline checks only establish plausibility.

ae-devtools.debug.ownedPid.description: PID of the ae-a8n owned AE session used to attest attach preflight. Attestation-grade only — the debugger cannot be aimed at a PID.
